findings.summary: README badge is a third-party vendor placement (Demoshell, run by the PR author) that the project doesn't control and that ships to PyPI; drop it
Badge line sits directly above --- so it renders as a setext H2 and the horizontal rule disappears
Changelog check will fail and the body doesn't ask for the skip label or tick the checklist

why: Finding 1 says the badge advertises an outside vendor's service that the maintainers don't run or control, and recommends dropping it, which matches the maintainer's reason about not advertising demos the core team doesn't maintain.
